differences.justification: SQLite without indexes does not finish these multi-join queries inside the per-query budget at SF0.01. The outcome depends on wall-clock speed, so the entry is optional. Performance limit of the engine on unindexed TPC-DS, not a translation difference.

SQLite without indexes does not finish TPC-H Q21 inside the per-query budget at SF0.01. The outcome depends on wall-clock speed, so the entry is optional. Performance limit of the engine on unindexed TPC-H, not a translation difference.

PostgreSQL without indexes does not finish TPC-H Q20 inside the per-query budget at SF0.01. The outcome depends on wall-clock speed, so the entry is optional. Performance limit of the engine on unindexed TPC-H, not a translation difference.

DataFusion previously computed this exact division as DECIMAL with six fractional digits; it is now computed as DOUBLE PRECISION. Both agree with the DuckDB reference within the comparison tolerance, and the candidate carries the digits beyond the sixth that the baseline rounded away. Output precision change, not a row difference.
